```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate the solid separator row or column.
    row_sep = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        first, second = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        colors1 = {x for row in first for x in row}
        colors2 = {x for row in second for x in row}
        shared = colors1 & colors2
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [
            [3 if first[r][c] == color and second[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(len(first))
        ]

    col_sep = next(c for c in range(w)
                   if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    first = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(col_sep)] for r in range(h)]
    second = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(col_sep + 1, w)] for r in range(h)]
    shared = ({x for row in first for x in row}
              & {x for row in second for x in row})
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [
        [3 if first[r][c] == color and second[r][c] == color else color
         for c in range(len(first[0]))]
        for r in range(h)
    ]
```
